video.title: Attention and the transformer: A mix, not a song
video.format_note: Animated explainer, 16:9, flat Darsi colours. Narration in the lesson language. Captions are separate files.
cast: Joseph - computer studies teacher, talking to a university class
Narrator - the Darsi voice, warm and precise, talking to a university student

scenes.narration: Eight notes sit in a row. The model does not hear music. It only counts which pitch followed which.
Today: attention, the transformer, and why eight notes are a count and not a song.
Attention scores every earlier item and mixes them. The new vector is a weighted sum.
A transformer block adds that mix back onto the original. Nothing is forced through one narrow state.
The Eight notes lab always picks the most common follower. A pitch it never saw follow another cannot appear.
Here is one transformer block. Attention mixes, and the residual adds the original back.
Quick check! Attention builds a new vector by doing what?
A weighted sum of the vectors it can see, its own included. The scores become weights, and the weights do the mixing.
In the app, open the Eight notes lab. Read the tune, then the four notes it writes next, and name one pitch it cannot invent.
Your turn. Did those eight notes compose a piece of music?
Remember this. Attention mixes, the residual keeps the original, and the eight notes only counted.
Try it tonight. Write one sentence on what was counted, and what was not.

checkpoints.prompt: Attention builds a new vector by doing what?

options.text: Keeping only the most recent vector
Adding the vectors with equal weights
Taking a weighted sum of the vectors it can see, itself included

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct: the scores become weights that add to one, and the new vector mixes every vector it can see, its own included.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite: attention takes a weighted sum of every vector it can see, its own included, not only the latest and not all equally.

checkpoints.prompt: Did those eight notes compose a piece of music?

options.text: Yes, they were trained for years

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct: they continued the counts from one short tune. They did not hear music.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite: eight notes continued a count. They are not a composition.
